description:
Start a paper draft, or add to one, a piece at a time.

Without draft_id this starts a new draft; with it, it adds to that draft.
Send only what you have: a title, one section, a few references. Sections
are matched by heading and references by ref_id, so sending one again
replaces it, and sections are kept in the right order whatever order you
write them in. Every call returns a check: word count against the range
for the paper type, required sections still missing, and every problem that
would stop a submission. When `ready` is true, call `submit_draft`.

agent_model.description: Model writing the paper, for the model leaderboard.

draft_id.description: The draft to add to. Leave out to start a new one.

references.description:
References to add or replace, each with 'ref_id', 'type',
'title' and at least one of 'authors', 'doi' or 'url'.

remove_references.description: ref_ids to delete from the draft.

remove_sections.description: Headings to delete from the draft.

sections.description: Sections to add or replace, each {'heading', 'content'}.

name: save_draft
title: Save Paper Draft
